newsitem.title: USA: Accom sees Q1 loss of $0.08-$0.10/shr.
newsitem.headline: Accom sees Q1 loss of $0.08-$0.10/shr.

text.p: Accom Inc Friday said it expects to report a loss in the first quarter of fiscal 1997 of between $0.08 and $0.10 a share.

In a statement, the company said revenues for the first quarter ended December 31 would be approximately $4.2 million, compared to revenues in the first quarter of fiscal 1996 of $5.5 million and to $5.9 million in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1996.
In the first quarter of fiscal 1996 Accom reported a profit of $141,000 or $0.02 a share.
Compared with the fourth quarter of fiscal 1996, the company said it experienced the most significant declines in shipments in its Axess clip and video server business and virtual set business.

Compared to the first quarter of 1996, the decline was due primarily to lower shipments of post production products and workstation disk products. Final results for the first quarter of will be announced on February 5 after the close of the market.
